title: Herbal Chewy Kenyan Raspberry Dumplings
description: A sweet, kid‑friendly Kenyan-inspired dumpling packed with fresh raspberries and aromatic herbs, served warm with a drizzle of honey for extra chewiness.
instructions: In a large bowl whisk together flour, baking powder and salt.
In a separate bowl beat the egg and milk, then stir in the melted butter.
Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and stir until a dough just comes together; let rest 10 minutes.
Gently fold in raspberries, mint, coriander and lemon zest, handling the dough softly to keep the berries intact.
Lightly oil a flat surface or a griddle and shape the dough into small, round dumplings (about 2 cm diameter) using a small cookie scoop or spoon.
Heat a skillet over medium heat and add a splash of olive oil. Place the dumplings and cook for 3–4 minutes per side until golden brown and the edges are firm.
Lower the heat to low, drizzle honey over the dumplings and let them sit for 1 minute to absorb the sweet glaze.
Serve the dumplings warm, optionally garnished with a few extra mint leaves or a light dusting of powdered sugar.
Enjoy the chewy texture and herbal aroma suitable for both kids and adults.
